items.reason: Inclusion: 'WHO grade III or IV glioma or glioblastoma or gliosarcoma', i.e. grade IV glioma with no IDH requirement and Roman-numeral WHO grading. Manual C8 counts 'grade 4/IV astrocytoma/glioma without an IDH requirement' as historical.

The title and summary state a pharmacodynamics objective ('demonstrate pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic effects in HGG tumors'), but the only registered outcomes are tissue/plasma xevinapant concentration and AEs, and the 'biomarker/PD studies' on archival tissue name no measurement.

note: target_engagement_planned set to unclear under D31-C6 (agreed 'yes' by coders, not queued). tumour_pk_planned stays yes (unbound xevinapant concentration in brain tumour tissue). No WHO 2021 citation, so cns5_terminology historical stands.
